mapper.select: select fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as productcode, to_char(fin.VDATE,'yyyyMMdd') as establishdate, to_char(fin.ACTMDATE,'yyyyMMdd') as expirydate, rule.YIELD as salefeerate, finadd.IS_LAY as islay from FIN_PRODUCT fin left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD finadd on fin.FINPROD_ID = finadd.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_CASH_INFO info on fin.FINPROD_ID = info.FINPROD_ID and info.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and info.IS_CALC = 'Y' left join (select finrule.CASH_ID as CASH_ID, max(finrule.EFF_DATE) as EFF_DATE from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE finrule where finrule.EFF_DATE <=to_date(#{cDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') group by finrule.CASH_ID ) dt on dt.CASH_ID = info.CASH_ID left join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE rule on fin.FINPROD_ID = rule.FINPROD_ID and rule.EFF_DATE = dt.EFF_DATE and rule.CASH_ID = dt.CASH_ID where fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{productcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{prodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select layparam.AMT_MIN ||','|| layparam.AMT_MAX as buyamtinterval, layparam.TERM_MIN ||','|| layparam.TERM_MAX as holddaysinterval, layparam.CUSTOM_LEVEL ||','|| layparam.CUSTOM_LEVEL as clientlevelinterval, rule.YIELD as bedyield, (case rule.BASIS when 'A/365' then '365' when 'A/360' then '360' end) as yearinterestdays from PRD_LAYER_PARAM layparam left join FIN_CASH_INFO info on info.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and info.FINPROD_TYPE = #{prodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and info.FINPROD_ID = layparam.FINPROD_ID left join (select finrule.CASH_ID as CASH_ID, max(finrule.EFF_DATE) as EFF_DATE from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE finrule where finrule.EFF_DATE <= to_date(#{cDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') group by finrule.CASH_ID ) dt on dt.CASH_ID = info.CASH_ID left join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE rule on rule.CASH_ID =info.CASH_ID and rule.EFF_DATE = dt.EFF_DATE and rule.CASH_ID = dt.CASH_ID where layparam.FINPROD_ID in (select fin.FINPROD_ID from FIN_PRODUCT fin where fin.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

select '1' ||','|| '999999999' as buyamtinterval, '1' ||','|| '9999' as holddaysinterval, '0' ||','|| '9' as clientlevelinterval, rule.YIELD as bedyield, (case rule.BASIS when 'A/365' then '365' when 'A/360' then '360' end) as yearinterestdays from FIN_CASH_INFO info left join (select finrule.CASH_ID as CASH_ID, max(finrule.EFF_DATE) as EFF_DATE from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE finrule where finrule.EFF_DATE <= to_date(#{cDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') group by finrule.CASH_ID ) dt on dt.CASH_ID = info.CASH_ID left join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE rule on rule.CASH_ID =info.CASH_ID and rule.EFF_DATE = dt.EFF_DATE where info.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and info.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and info.FINPROD_TYPE = #{prodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
